title: Klahn Dragon Fire Shiraz Gin
description:
Our boldest pour. Dragon Fire takes the estate Shiraz gin and turns everything up — bottled at a full 50% ABV, with the dark fruit, pepper and juniper carrying real heat through a long, smouldering finish.

For the drinker who orders the strong one on purpose.
serve: Neat or over a single large cube. Approach with respect.
